title: Pastepin
tagline: Pastepin is a decentralized pastebin that allows you to share text and files easily.
description: Pastepin (https://pastepin.xyz) is a site for sharing text and files in a decentralized manner using web3.storage. Existing pastebins all store their data in a centralized database which can be taken down anytime. Using Pastepin, your data is stored securely on the decentralized IPFS network.
how_its_made:
Tech stack: web3.storage (Filecoin + IPFS), ethers.js (Signing & Verifying), Next.js (React, hosted on Vercel).



The web3.storage package made development super easy. And here's an example pin that was created using Pastepin: https://ipfs.io/ipfs/bafybeicpobav5guppsmroeodnjl5bjeoy76dlttvtffu7lo4gd7rhpekqa
